prompt: Set up a daily auto-update cron job for OpenClaw at 4 AM.
expected: Reads references/scheduler.md, creates cron job, initializes state in <state_root>.
actual: Resolved <state_root> to <workspace>/auto-update/. Evaluated `references/scheduler.md`. Created cron job with `openclaw cron add --name "Auto-Update" --cron "0 4 * * *"`.

prompt: Check if it's safe to update the garden skill by reviewing migration risk.
expected: Reads references/migrations.md, compares installed skill vs new version, reports migration risk if stateful paths changed.
actual: Resolved <state_root> to <workspace>/auto-update/. Read `references/migrations.md`. Diffed local garden installation against update candidate. No state paths changed. Safe to update.

prompt: Run an update check now for all auto-updating skills and summarize the run.
expected: Reads references/execution.md and references/reports.md, checks openclaw and clawic list, performs updates and logs to run-log.md.
actual: Resolved <state_root>. Read `references/execution.md` and `references/reports.md`. Backed up 2 out-of-date skills. Updated 2 skills. Logged summary to <state_root>/run-log.md.
